title: N8nCarSearchWebhookResponse
description: JSON body returned by the n8n car-search workflow in its HTTP response to the Next.js server. Requires the n8n Webhook node to use responseMode: responseNode and a terminal Respond to Webhook node.

status.description: Always 'success' when the workflow reaches the Respond to Webhook node. Failure is indicated by a non-2xx HTTP status code.

results.description: All matched CarListing records (up to the workflow's internal query limit). The Next.js server caps display at 5 items. Empty array means no matches.

bodyType.description: Body type (e.g., hatchback, suv). null if not present in the record.

price.description: Asking price in EUR. null if not present in the record.

sourceUrl.description: Source listing URL. Derived from the CarListing 'source' field. null if the source field is not a valid URL.

totalCount.description: Total number of matched records in the database (may exceed the results array length if the workflow applies its own internal limit).
